community.faq.heading: Community FAQ
community.faq.q1: Where is the primary place you answer questions?
community.faq.a1: On X (@0xlenador) I interact and reply to threads daily. For group debates and peer-to-peer strategy questions, the Telegram group is the most direct spot.
community.faq.q2: When will Discord and WhatsApp be available?
community.faq.a2: Both are currently in development. Discord will launch once role perimeters and automated feeds are set, and WhatsApp will serve as a low-noise urgent broadcast list.
community.faq.q3: How can I verify official accounts?
community.faq.a3: All authenticated links are published on this /en/community/ page. I will never ask for your private keys, seed phrases, or DM you offering investment schemes.
